name: Lifetime ISA: rules for buying a first home

sources.title: Lifetime ISA: withdrawing money from your Lifetime ISA
First Time Buyer ISA: consultation (HM Treasury, updated 29 June 2026)

rules: The home must cost £450,000 or less.
You must buy at least 12 months after your first payment into the Lifetime ISA.
You must buy with a mortgage and use a conveyancer or solicitor.
The government adds a 25% bonus to what you pay in: up to £4,000 a year, so up to £1,000 bonus a year.
If you take money out for any other reason before age 60, you pay a 25% withdrawal charge.
pendingChange: In June 2026 the government consulted on replacing the Lifetime ISA with a First Time Buyer ISA. No launch date is set. Until then you can still open a Lifetime ISA, and existing accounts keep the current rules.
